author: melissa proctor clark
text: Very Responsive. On time appointments. Got in and out without tearing up my yard or leaving a mess! Price was VERY REASONABLE!!! I was pleasantly surprised! Because I was charged way more by the last company I used. I would highly recommend them in the Shelby area!!!

author: patrice beasley
text: I'm a first time homeowner and had my first experience with a septic tank issue. After the actual builder didn't offer any help, I turned to these guys. They called me back in less than an hour. Pulled up on me within 15 minutes because they were in the area. Supplied thorough and knowledgeable help for my issue. It's an issue that needs to be taken care of by whoever installed the tank, but Trent Rhea's didn't charge for their time and knowledge and I appreciate that! I'd recommend them 10 times out of 10.

author: Tyler Davis
text: Trent and his team did a great job assisting me with identifying and solving the issue with my septic system. He and his team were very customer friendly and took time explain everything that they were doing. A very honest and affordable company. I would highly recommend.

author: Sandie Della Sala
text: I received reasonably priced same-day service. The quality of the work was excellent, and the team was very professional. I would highly recommend their services to anyone in need!

author: Ryan Stephens
text: Had Rhea's out today for a scheduled pump out.  Gave a call ahead prior to arrival.  Very courteous, friendly, and professional.  Gave me some insights on putting more dirt down to slope away from the drain field.  Already have a calendar reminder to have it pumped out in three more years.  Rhea's said every three to five but I'll go every three years due to how easy they make it.
